1) we propose a new method for detecting camera artifacts based on pixel-wise correlation of consecutive camera images; 2) the new method can detect three types of camera artifacts: raindrops and dirt on the camera lens and scratches on the image sensor; 3) we show how the new method can be efficiently implemented by means of box filters.
